column2: [intro]
I grew up without a true passion for these notes that play,
For the turns that twist,
I don't care about virtuosity,
I've never had a taste for symphonies.
But words are enough when they come from the heart,
To say what I want, I don't need music's art.
It's so much simpler when I sing with my words,
To express my emotions, I don't need any chords.
I don’t care for notes, music, or chords,
A few words orchestrated are enough for my melody.
I carry my wonderful tales,
That's my heritage, I’m proud to say.
